cand.title: Congreso Nacional de Cardiología Punta Cana 2027
cand.excerpt: High evidence and clear hospitality mechanism; current-edition accessibility is discounted where a competing venue is named.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified commercially relevant entry points: Dra. Carmen Encarnación, 2027 Organizing Committee chair responsible for logistics/operations; and Dra. Vizmary Pineda Frías, SODOCARDIO president for 2025–2027 and congress launch spokesperson. Their roles justify outreach, not a claim of hotel-contract signature authority. Dr. Franklin/Franklyn Colón chairs the scientific committee and is a secondary program-requirements contact, not an evidenced lodging buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Announced for 17–20 June 2027 in Punta Cana, within the requested horizon. These are activity dates, not the 14–17 June 2026 article/publication dates. Multiple event-launch reports agree on the 31st edition and joint III SIAC Cardiooncology Congress. Specific 2027 dates and venue are supported by launch reporting; no edition-specific primary association announcement or booking page was located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment using the supplied hotel specifications: Wyndham Alltra’s 620 guestrooms and all-inclusive resort format support a hypothetical guestroom-led medical group, but its three meeting venues/~380 m²/~300 conference capacity are a material limitation for this congress. Reporting specifies five simultaneous academic rooms in 2027, so do not pitch Alltra as a like-for-like replacement for the full congress. Smaller association meetings, sponsor groups or ancillary stays are conditional relationship-development propositions, not verified demand.
findings.venueCommitments: Announced venue: Centro de Convenciones del Hard Rock Hotel Punta Cana. This is an explicit competing-hotel venue designation, reinforced by planned RCP training for Hard Rock personnel. It is not evidence of an executed venue contract, room allotment, exclusivity or accommodation sell-out.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified biennial series, not annual. Archived editions: 15–18 May 2019, 3–6 June 2021, 22–25 June 2023 and 19–22 June 2025, all in Punta Cana. Official programs identify Hard Rock for 2019 and 2021; the association explicitly identifies Hard Rock for 2023, and its 2025 invitation letter also names Hard Rock. The 2027 announcement therefore continues a documented incumbent pattern, not demonstrated destination rotation.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 lodging sourcing is unknown: no published room block, rates, reservations pathway, release date, open RFP or alternative-hotel allocation was found. Turinter is explicitly the organizing agency on the 2025 congress website, with cardiologia@turinter.com, 809-686-4020 and 829-760-5526. That historical assignment does not establish a 2027 appointment or purchasing authority.
findings.organizationStructure: SODOCARDIO (Sociedad Dominicana de Cardiología, Inc.) is the medical association/event owner, not a travel intermediary. Its national board appoints a congress organizing committee with executive faculties. SIAC supplies the joint cardiooncology congress; Hard Rock is the announced venue. Turinter is a separately identified organizing agency for 2025 only; its 2027 appointment is unverified. The supplied travel-trade segment should not be interpreted as the owner’s organization type.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Hard Rock is the announced 2027 venue and a repeatedly documented historical host. Five concurrent academic rooms create a concrete functional disadvantage for Alltra’s supplied three-venue product. No sourced evidence establishes Hard Rock room shortages, overflow, hotel dissatisfaction, displacement or offsite accommodation demand. No demand at Cap Cana, La Romana or Bayahibe is being attributed to this hotel.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact the SODOCARDIO Santo Domingo office at sodocardiord@gmail.com / 809-685-0331, requesting routing to Carmen Encarnación and Vizmary Pineda. Acknowledge the Hard Rock commitment; ask who controls 2027 accommodation, whether offsite hotel use is permitted, whether any unfunded/unstaffed lodging need exists, and whether Turinter is reappointed. Only if a need is confirmed, submit a right-sized Alltra guestroom-led proposal with separately costed transport and small-meeting arrangements. Otherwise seek permission to discuss smaller programmes and the next venue-review cycle; do not issue a speculative main-congress proposal.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming 2027 edition, the main congress venue is already announced elsewhere; do not present it as an accessible open venue sale. Guestroom contracting may or may not be committed: status unknown. An Alltra ancillary lodging proposal is appropriate only if the organizing committee confirms permitted offsite accommodation and a real unmet requirement.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: the association’s explicitly biennial congress provides a recurring relationship-development path beyond 2027, but no later edition dates or destination were verified. A 2029 national edition would be an expectation from the published cycle, outside this investigation horizon, not a confirmed opportunity. Given Alltra’s meeting-space mismatch and the Hard Rock incumbent pattern, prioritize smaller separately scoped association/sponsor programmes rather than assume capture of the entire national congress.

Ask Carmen Encarnación to identify the accommodation contracting lead and confirm whether Turinter has a 2027 mandate; request offsite-hotel rules and only published or organizer-confirmed room requirements.

If 2027 is fully placed, ask the association president for smaller programme opportunities, future committee transition and the next venue-review timetable; retain the full-congress meeting-space constraint.
